scoring_justification: Recomputation from raw DFT artifacts is infeasible because the agent only submits the aggregated numeric quantities; the checker compares each reported value to the paper's reported gold numbers with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for CTL_p1_0, CTL_0_m1, KS_energy_difference, TDM, ZPL
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported values from the original publication; no fabrication needed.

outputs.description: Final computed properties for the Co_S^0 defect: thermodynamic charge transition levels, single-particle excitation energy, transition dipole moment, and zero-phonon line.

output_contract.notes: All quantities are compared to hidden reference values from the paper with appropriate tolerances. The solver must produce this file after completing all preceding process steps.
